predictors.president20: Contemporaneous 2020 response, not later recalled profiles; keep contest nonvote, reported election nonvote and unknown distinct.
predictors.age20: Approximate calendar-year age 2020 minus birthyr_20; bins18-29/30-44/45-64/65+; missing or outside18..110 stays UNKNOWN, never dropped or treated as eligibility proof.
predictors.education20: Literal native categorical codes1..6; no numeric labels inferred from PDF display order.
predictors.state20: 2020 survey-state categorical FIPS, not current matched-record geography or election-day residence.

targets.administrative_pair: Full3x3 POSITIVE/EXPLICIT_NONVOTE/UNKNOWN at2022 and2024, not repaired from reported House choice.
targets.House_response_pair: Full6x5 reported House classes: D/R/O/contest-nonvote/reported-election-nonvote/unknown at2022; no unsupported election-nonvote code12 at2024.

ridge_support_regularization: Each head mixes raw model probabilities with training-only Dirichlet(alpha=.5/class) prior by epsilon=1/(training_n+1); absent training classes explicitly supported. This is fixed regularization, not post-score flooring.
stratification: Only contemporaneous2020president feature; seeded shuffled round-robin with seeded stratum offsets. No later outcomes used in splits.

primary_known_major_diagnostic.forecast: Normalize OOF House-pair probabilities to four D/R pairs within each already selected actual both-positive-history/both-major-choice reference case; aggregate source weights.
primary_known_major_diagnostic.marginal_matching: Normalize predicted pooled table to reference weight total, then fit only reference row/column margins, preserving forecast cross-product odds ratio. Do not fit observed switching or odds ratio.
primary_known_major_diagnostic.report: All five unconstrained and marginal-matched2x2 synthetic tables, gross-switch errors, matching residuals and odds-ratio preservation.

fold_stress: All126multisets of5outer-fold draws, with multinomial multiplicities summing3125; compare paired versus independent losses at matched feature level. Overlapping training folds make this a fold-composition stress grid, NOT confidence intervals or independent resampling units.

publication.allowed: Pooled model/frame/fold loss sufficient sums, primary selected-cohort synthetic forecasts, exact previously public2x2reference, complete score/flow/stress/query outputs/code/tests/replay.
publication.forbidden: Persons, identifiers, per-case labels/features/predictions/losses, native fine cells, state model coefficients or state benchmarks.
